description: This file defines an API client for a notes application, utilizing axios for HTTP requests. It manages configuration based on environment variables, handles request and response interceptors for logging and error handling, and provides functions for CRUD operations on notes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, summarizing, and importing notes.

methods.name: getApiErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on the API error response or fallback message.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes, with optional pagination and search parameters.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the provided title and content.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its ID with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: summarizeNote
methods.description: Generates a summary for a note by its ID.

methods.name: importNoteFromFile
methods.description: Imports a note from a file, available only in no-auth mode.
